manual_decisions.decision: Authorize one additional scoped fix loop with all required repeat gates.

assumptions.decision: Treat the Issue's named primitives as an internal library extension, not a public npm compatibility commitment.
assumptions.reason: The repository package is private and public npm publishing is a stated non-goal.
assumptions.impact: The explicit component workflow label remains eligible; promote to full if external publication or relied-upon compatibility emerges.

assumptions.decision: Interpret 'Form' as composable field primitives, not validation, submission, or data-management behavior.
assumptions.reason: The Issue names basic HTML elements but does not define business validation or submission semantics.
assumptions.impact: The scope stays reusable and product-neutral; product-specific validation, submission, persistence, and theming are excluded.

open_findings.title: Field label association can target the wrong control
open_findings.description: Field can preserve a caller-supplied child id while its generated Label htmlFor still targets a different generated id.
evidence: packages/react-library/src/Field.tsx: generated controlId and child id merge
open_findings.resolution: A caller-supplied child id now drives the Field Label/help/error association, with a conflicting-id regression test; independently confirmed in re-review.

open_findings.title: Required Form primitive is absent
open_findings.description: The approved Form/Field requirement is not met because Form is absent from source, exports, documentation, stories, and the package contract.
evidence: packages/react-library/src/index.ts exports Field but no Form
open_findings.resolution: A native ref-forwarding Form primitive is exported with documentation, stories, tests, declarations, and clean-consumer package coverage; independently confirmed in re-review.

open_findings.title: Select removes the native size attribute from its public API
open_findings.description: Select replaces the ordinary native SelectHTMLAttributes size attribute with design-system size values and therefore cannot preserve native multi-row/listbox semantics.
evidence: packages/react-library/src/Select.tsx omits native size and emits data-size
packages/react-library/README.md says native select props are accepted
open_findings.resolution: Numeric native size values now reach the select element while preserving token styling; independently confirmed in final review.

open_findings.title: Switch lacks a discoverable focus-visible Storybook state
open_findings.description: Switch has no focus-visible story even though the approved documentation contract requires representative focus-visible states for interactive primitives.
evidence: packages/react-library/src/Switch.stories.tsx has unchecked, checked, and disabled states only
packages/react-library/scripts/verify-storybook-browser.mjs has no Switch focus-visible story inventory
open_findings.resolution: A discoverable visibly focused Switch Storybook state and browser check were added; independently confirmed in final review.
